evals.prompt: 帮我创建一个Geant4项目，模拟10MeV的中子打向铝靶，我想要一个完整的可以编译运行的项目
evals.expected_output: A complete Geant4 project with CMakeLists.txt, main file, DetectorConstruction, PrimaryGeneratorAction, and visualization macro. All code should have Chinese comments.
assertions: Main .cc file exists with ActionInitialization pattern (no SetUserAction in main)
DetectorConstruction uses G4_Al for aluminum target
Uses FTFP_BERT physics list (not outdated QGSP_BERT)
Chinese comments present in source files

evals.prompt: 我想在我的Geant4模拟中添加数据收集功能，记录粒子在靶中的能量沉积和位置信息，然后输出到ROOT文件
evals.expected_output: Action classes (RunAction, EventAction, SteppingAction) for data collection with ROOT output. Should use ActionInitialization to register actions. SteppingAction accumulates energy via EventAction, not writing ntuple directly.
assertions: RunAction, EventAction, SteppingAction files exist in include/ and src/
SteppingAction calls GetTotalEnergyDeposit and AddEnergyDeposit (per-event pattern)
Chinese comments present in source files

evals.prompt: 我想模拟一个伽马射线源，能量在1到10MeV之间随机分布，各向同性发射，打到一个圆柱形的锗探测器上
evals.expected_output: PrimaryGeneratorAction with random energy and isotropic direction, DetectorConstruction with cylindrical germanium detector. Uses a custom physics list with G4EmLivermorePhysics or G4EmPenelopePhysics for low-energy gamma. Uses ActionInitialization.
assertions: Uses a custom physics list with G4EmLivermorePhysics or G4EmPenelopePhysics
Chinese comments present in source files
